description:
The BEST Insurance Stocks To Secure Your Portfolio's | Dipan Mehta | Sector का राजा

In this episode dipan mehta from paisasmart break down the Indian insurance sector why it matters, how the business models differ (General, Health, Life, Services) and exactly what investors should watch (combined ratio, embedded value). I explain the simplest valuation rules for life insurers, the key efficiency metric for general insurers, and the platform play that gives a one-stock exposure to the whole insurance ecosystem. 

Whether you’re a long-term investor hunting steady compounding businesses or a trader looking for sector leaders, this video simplifies the complex insurance industry into clear action points and stock ideas. Subscribe for more stock market deep dives. 

Companies Discussed:
General Insurance: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re), Go Digit General Insurance, ICICI Lombard General Insurance, New India Assurance 
Health Insurance: Niva Bupa Health Insurance, Star Health and Allied Insurance 
Life Insurance: HDFC Life Insurance, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), Max Financial Services, SBI Life Insurance 
Insurance Services: Medi Assist Healthcare Services, PB Fintech Limited
